summary: Second Life entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Second Life

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: Second Life is a live virtual world. The official desktop viewer is the best fidelity and interaction route, while mobile is useful for access but documented as a separate, more limited mobile app route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Windows desktop viewer on a capable PC. Record the viewer version, region, and date, because user-created locations and live social spaces change constantly.

all_releases.fidelity: Official full desktop viewer route for graphics, building, interaction, and capture.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity and most complete interaction route for the live world.

all_releases.fidelity: Popular alternative viewers can add features, but they are not the cleanest official archive baseline.
all_releases.reason: skip: use only for specific accessibility or compatibility needs.

all_releases.fidelity: Official mobile app for social/exploration access, now available to all users.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful companion route, but less complete than desktop for full viewer interactions and capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive story or mission content is sourced; the archive concern is live-world impermanence and viewer capability differences.

entries.remaster_caveats: Second Life is user-generated and live; regions, events, avatars, scripts, and viewer behavior can change or disappear, so capture metadata matters.
